class.name: HTMLShadowRoot
class.brief_description: A separate DOM tree attached to a host element.
class.description: Created with [method HTMLElement.attach_shadow] or a declarative template. Its children are excluded from document queries. Slot assignment changes rendering without moving the host's child nodes.

members.member: The host of this shadow tree.
Either open or closed. Closed roots are hidden by the host's shadow_root getter.
